title: Kinetic title
description: One to three lines that build word by word (blur-rise with a small overshoot); one accent word in the italic serif and accent colour; optional underline sweep and exit.

lines.description: Lines of the headline. Keep each under ~14 characters at fontSize 120.

accentWord.description: Word set in the accent font and colour (matched case-insensitively, punctuation ignored). Empty for none.

eyebrow.description: Small mono label above the headline. Empty to hide.

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47, e.g. en, tr, de). Sets <html lang>, which drives uppercase rules (tr: i -> İ).

start.description: Second the first element appears (scene-local; voiceover time minus the scene start).

underline.description: Accent bar sweeping in under the headline.

exit.description: Words leave in reverse order before the end.

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: textcheck: no line cut off at the chosen fontSize
readcheck: headline readable for >= 1.5 s after it settles
